derivation_disclosure: Frozen after r824 showed that real-domain object-distance supervision is insufficient and before extracting or scoring any r825 real feature. This removes the object teacher and directly conditions frozen visual patches on the supplied route field. No bbox, detector marker, obstacle-hit, trace score, lifecycle transition, threshold search, or trainable backbone is used.

representation.visual: frozen Depth Anything V2 DINO-S layer 11 patch grid at 224
representation.projection: fixed Gaussian 384x32 matrix divided by sqrt(384)
representation.feature: route-weighted projected mean, off-route-weighted projected mean, and their contrast
representation.uniform_control: same feature function with constant 0.5 field
representation.event_aggregation: arithmetic mean over all event frames
